name: What level of involvement can I expect to have with my remodeling project coordinator?

mainEntity.name: What level of involvement can I expect to have with my remodeling project coordinator?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can expect a high level of collaborative involvement with your remodeling project coordinator. While they manage the day-to-day operations, they serve as your primary point of contact, providing regular updates on progress, budget, and schedule. They will involve you in key decisions regarding materials, design adjustments, and any unforeseen challenges. Their role is to translate technical aspects, ensuring your vision is realized while minimizing the need for your constant direct oversight of the construction site.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect collaborative involvement with regular updates on progress and budget, and participation in key decisions, with the coordinator managing day-to-day operations.
